How the Meta-Models work: the probability-only and context-aware models use leakage-safe out-of-fold base-model predictions; Meta-Model V3 adds nonlinear Random Forest stacking with engineered disagreement, rating, form, chemistry, corner, and matchup context features. All base predictions and context inputs are generated without using the target game's outcome, preventing target leakage.

Weight selection: the ensemble weights were optimized by minimizing Brier score on the pre-holdout, leakage-safe OOF predictions from Random Forest, Context-Aware Meta-Model, and Meta-Model V3. The final holdout games were not used to select the weights.
